title: EntityLifecycleStages
description: The lifecycle stages entities can be in, the entity types that have a lifecycle stage (an `entityStatus` property), the stages each type uses and the moves between them, and the active workflows that own each type's stage. Entity types that are not listed have no lifecycle.

stageTransition.description: The stages an entity can move to from one stage.

to.description: Stages the entity can move to from it.

entityType.description: Entity type that has a lifecycle stage.

stages.description: Stages an entity of this type can be in. Most types use the general stages; a type with a lifecycle of its own uses the stages it declares, which can include stages no other type has.

transitions.description: The moves this entity type allows between its stages. Any other stage change is rejected.

stageWorkflows.description: Active governance workflows that own this entity type's lifecycle stage. While one of them applies to an entity, its stage changes only through that workflow and a direct change is rejected. More than one means the workflows overwrite each other's stage.

stages.description: Every lifecycle stage an entity can be in. Each entity type uses the stages its own entry lists.

entityTypes.description: Entity types that have a lifecycle stage, sorted by name.
